basic_info.description: Located in the heart of Potrero Hill, this meticulously maintained triplex offers sweeping city views, exceptional livability, and strong income potential all in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. The property includes three spacious 1BD/1BA units across two levels, each with private deck space. The vacant rear unit is a standout, boasting panoramic city views, a private deck, and an additional office, making it an ideal owner-occupancy opportunity. The other two units are tenant-occupied at strong rental rates, providing stable income for investors or helping offset mortgage costs for future owner-users. Built in 1958, the building retains its charming mid-century character and benefits from extensive upgrades: a new 75-gallon water heater (2025), modified bitumen roof with permits (2024), exterior painting (2024), remodeled kitchens and a full bathroom remdodel in Unit 2 (2023), upgraded 4-meter electrical service and new panels (2013), dual-pane windows and sliders (2011), and fire sprinklers in the garage and basement (2004). Tenants pay all utilities including PG&E, water, and trash minimizing expenses. Located directly across from the Carolina green space and near Potrero's best cafes, restaurants, Caltrain, UCSF, and Chase Center.
